title: The Colosseum's Opening Day, 80 CE
description: Tens of thousands of Romans, a giant sail roof and games that ran for 100 days. What the Colosseum looked like when it opened.

scenes.narration: It's the year 80, and you're in a crowd of tens of thousands, walking into the newest building in Rome.
scenes.image_prompt: huge crowd of ancient Romans in togas and tunics streaming toward a brand new gleaming travertine amphitheatre, sunny day, 80 CE

scenes.narration: The emperor Titus has just finished the Flavian Amphitheatre. We call it the Colosseum.
scenes.image_prompt: Roman emperor Titus in purple toga standing in the imperial box of the Colosseum raising his hand to the crowd

scenes.narration: The outside is bright travertine stone, with arches stacked in rows and statues filling them.
scenes.image_prompt: exterior of the brand new Colosseum with complete arcades of arches on several levels, marble statues standing in the upper arches, clear sky

scenes.narration: Your ticket points you to a numbered entrance. Seating is arranged by social rank.
scenes.image_prompt: ancient Roman spectators entering through a numbered arched entrance, stone stairways inside, guards checking clay tokens

scenes.narration: Above you, sailors rig a huge canvas awning, the velarium, to shade the crowd.
scenes.image_prompt: giant canvas awning stretched over the top of the Colosseum on ropes and wooden masts, sailors pulling ropes, sunlight filtering through

scenes.narration: The opening games last a hundred days, with animal hunts and gladiator fights.
scenes.image_prompt: packed Colosseum seen from the upper seats during games, sandy arena floor below, gladiators small in the distance, roaring crowd

scenes.narration: Later, under Domitian, a maze of tunnels and lifts was built under the arena floor.
scenes.image_prompt: underground stone tunnels beneath the Colosseum arena, wooden lift mechanisms and cages, workers pulling ropes by torchlight

scenes.narration: Earthquakes and stone robbers took half of it. Which ancient city should we visit next? Comment below.
scenes.image_prompt: the Colosseum today, partly ruined outer wall, tourists around it, warm sunset light over Rome
